assertions.requirement: Create a named secret through the real API and require its exact name once in the list.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy create then list status 200; assertSecretListPrivacy requires the exact name once.

assertions.requirement: Inspect the untransformed list response for plaintext leakage and reject values/encrypted_values/encryptedValues or other unknown fields using the canonical strict schema.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts; src/shared/api-contract/secrets-schemas.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy assertSecretListPrivacy rejects the plaintext value anywhere in the raw list body and parses it with the strict listSecretsResponseSchema, so any values-like extra key fails.

assertions.requirement: GET /v1/secrets/:name must return 404 and expose no material route.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy single-secret GET by name returns status 404.

assertions.requirement: Require 204 for the initial and repeated DELETE, then verify list absence.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy two DELETE calls each status 204, then list absence.

assertions.requirement: A real non-force DELETE of a secret referenced by an active Workload must return the declared SECRET_IN_USE/409 with the exact secret name and blocking Workload ID, while the secret remains listed without its material.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy deleteSecret with force false rejects with ORPCError declared SECRET_IN_USE status 409 while the referencing Workload is active.

assertions.requirement: Force deletion of the referenced secret must succeed and prove exact-name absence through the same endpoint before its tracked cleanup completes; terminate the no-provision reference fixture afterward.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.secretCrudPrivacy deleteSecret with force true succeeds and the list proves exact-name absence before the Workload is terminated.

assertions.requirement: A submission naming a never-created secret, or the secret just force-deleted, is rejected at admission with the declared WORKLOAD_ADMISSION_REJECTED (400) and the exact message Secret "<name>" not found, and persists no Workload row for either id.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/api-auth.ts; src/api/rpc/workload-admission.ts; src/api/services/workload-operation-helpers.ts: ApiAuthScenarios.#missingSecretAdmission submits the deleted and a never-created secret name through createWorkload with an explicit credentialless Local target that needs no catalog download; declaredApiError code WORKLOAD_ADMISSION_REJECTED status 400 with the preflightRuntimeSecrets message; queryComplete proves zero workloads rows per id.
